_comment2: The presets below carry their own edges: a name that collides with an EFFECT search term ("Blurry Fade In" answers 'blur' too), two that differ only by folder, and one from the user's own folder with a redirected, localised Documents path in it - which is the path shape the walk had to be taught to find.
_comment: A hand-made stand-in for the catalogue the plug-in writes at %APPDATA%\pieFX\effects.json. The harness passes it with --effects so the search window can be driven with a KNOWN list instead of whatever this machine has installed. It is deliberately small AND deliberately nasty: it carries one of each of the catalogue's three sharp edges, so a filter that ignores them fails here rather than in front of a user. Levels appears twice, once live and once _Obsolete, which is a real collision in AE's own list; ADBE Pseudo/ and the empty category are the internal entries; and ADBE Bilateral Blur Vertical Radius is 31 characters, the truncation cap.

presets.name: Fade In
presets.path: C:\Program Files\Adobe\Adobe After Effects 2026\Support Files\Presets\Adobe Express\In\Fade In.ffx
